final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rental_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_rental_price, avg_per_day_rental_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rental_price) FROM rating_averages) AS relative_per_day_price FROM rating_averages ORDER BY rating
